rulings.rationale: Keep the dated formula with the community claim it grammatically introduces; the closing paragraph mark and renewed word event make 1:2 the safe endpoint.
rulings.counterevidence: The date and addressee notice has a recoverable framing function and governs more than the quoted claim, but that metadata function does not outweigh its syntactic dependence.

rulings.rationale: Preserve the accusation, consider summons, and futility outcomes as one result-bearing oracle rather than detaching its memorable scarcity list.
rulings.counterevidence: The divine-speech formula near the consider summons and the memorable list create internal rhetorical turns, while the repeated consider formula at 1:7 links both confrontation movements.
rulings.rejected_alternative: Hag.1.3-Hag.1.5 plus Hag.1.6-Hag.1.6; Hag.1.4-Hag.1.6; Hag.1.3-Hag.1.11; Separate chunks for individual futility outcomes

rulings.rationale: Commission, disappointed expectation, causal explanation, and drought register answer one another and reach their marked closure together at 1:11.
rulings.counterevidence: The imperative cluster at 1:8 and the expectation-and-explanation turn at 1:9 are recoverable internal movements.
rulings.rejected_alternative: Hag.1.7-Hag.1.8 plus Hag.1.9-Hag.1.11; Hag.1.8-Hag.1.8; Hag.1.9-Hag.1.11; Hag.1.3-Hag.1.11; Separate chunks for drought-list members

rulings.rationale: The bare date at 1:15 identifies when the narrated work occurred, so it remains a dependent coda inside the obedience, assurance, stirring, and work response.
rulings.counterevidence: The WLC-family pe after 1:14 is genuine evidence for a dependent date-coda seam, and the messenger assurance at 1:13 is a distinct embedded speech.

rulings.rationale: Former-glory questions, threefold strengthening, work command, and covenant-presence reassurance comprise one encouragement child before the marked 2:5 seam.
rulings.counterevidence: The encouragement at 2:4 and compressed covenant-and-Spirit relation at 2:5 are internal turns, while the causal opening at 2:6 keeps this child dependent on the full 2:1-9 oracle.
rulings.rejected_alternative: Hag.2.1-Hag.2.3 plus Hag.2.4-Hag.2.5; Hag.2.4-Hag.2.5; Hag.2.4-Hag.2.4; Hag.2.1-Hag.2.9

rulings.rationale: Creation and nations shaking moves through resources to latter house glory and peace; splitting its statements would sever the promise from its stated result.
rulings.counterevidence: The causal opening links backward to 2:1-5, and repeated speech formulas plus the declaration at 2:8 create internal turns.
rulings.rejected_alternative: Hag.2.6-Hag.2.7; Hag.2.6-Hag.2.8 plus Hag.2.9-Hag.2.9; Hag.2.6-Hag.2.7 plus Hag.2.8-Hag.2.9; Hag.2.9-Hag.2.9; Hag.2.1-Hag.2.9

rulings.rationale: The two priestly cases are intentionally paired and receive their literary result in Haggai application, so no answer or application can safely surface alone.
rulings.counterevidence: Each priestly exchange is formally complete, 2:14 changes from dialogue to application, and no WLC-family paragraph marker closes after 2:14.

rulings.rationale: The first consider summons carries a complete negative retrospective through shortfall, agricultural strikes, and failed return before the command and time threshold restart.
rulings.counterevidence: This is the negative first half of a larger reversal whose blessing arrives only in 2:18-19; it must retain the 2:15-19 parent.
rulings.rejected_alternative: Hag.2.15-Hag.2.19; Separate chunks for individual agricultural losses; Hag.2.15-Hag.2.16 plus Hag.2.17-Hag.2.17

rulings.rationale: The repeated consider command and foundation-day threshold open a blessing child whose crop inventory, reversal promise, and paragraph closure complete at 2:19.
rulings.counterevidence: The child cannot establish the force of its reversal without the shortfall and failed-return history in 2:15-17, so isolated retrieval is prohibited by mandatory parent hydration.

rulings.rationale: The explicit second same-day word governs the overthrow catalogue and its servant-signet culmination through the terminal speech formula.
rulings.counterevidence: Hag.2.23 changes from broad overthrow imagery to highly retrievable personal servant, signet, and election language, but it is the addressed culmination rather than an independent identity oracle.
